name: Moon The
overview: Scripture reveals that the moon, created by God as the lesser light to govern the night, serves specific purposes such as providing light on earth and marking signs, seasons, days, and years (Genesis 1:14-16). While the moon has its own glory and was ordained by God for the benefit of all, the Israelites were warned against worshipping it or any heavenly host, as such idolatry was prohibited and punishable (Deuteronomy 4:19; 17:3-4). Thus, the moon’s design points to God’s sovereign order and calls believers to honor Him alone.
